# Templates and references
## PNG template
A template is a picture you trace over, such as a floor plan or a sprite of a ship. It's drawn under the map or over it at the size, angle and opacity you set.
Open the Template tab and press [bold]Load PNG[/bold]. The image lands centred on your view. A new load replaces the old one.
[bold]Show[/bold] Hide or show it. [bold]Lock[/bold] Dragging, the wheel and the arrows leave it alone. [bold]Layer[/bold] Under the map or Over the map. [bold]Centre (tiles)[/bold] Where its middle sits. [bold]Scale[/bold] X and Y. [bold]Keep proportions[/bold] changes both together. [bold]Pixels per tile[/bold] Size at scale 1. 32 matches a game sprite. [bold]Rotation[/bold] In degrees. [bold]Opacity[/bold] How see-through it is. [bold]Reset[/bold] Default scale, rotation and opacity, centred on your view. [bold]Clear[/bold] Remove your template and its saved copy.
Press 7 for Template mode to move it with the mouse:
[bold]Drag[/bold] Move [bold]Ctrl+drag[/bold] Scale [bold]Shift+drag[/bold] Rotate [bold]Wheel[/bold] Scale [bold]Arrow keys[/bold] Nudge one pixel. Shift nudges eight. [bold]Right click[/bold], [bold]Escape[/bold] Drop the drag and put it back
The template shows only on the level you loaded it on. It's kept on your computer under the session's name and comes back whenever you enter a session of that name. A PNG can be up to 16 MiB and 8192 pixels a side.
## Sharing a template
Your template is yours alone until you press [bold]Share with session[/bold]. Then every member sees it, and anyone can move, scale or turn it for everyone. Opacity, Show and Lock stay your own. A new share replaces the last one. [bold]Unshare[/bold] takes it away for everyone.
A shared template is saved with the map and comes back when the version is opened. Downloads and uploads leave it out. Shares are up to 8 MiB.
## Reference grids
A reference is a copy of a game ship, a game map or a level of one of your own maps, dropped onto your map to look at or copy from.
- Open the Mapping window's [bold]Reference[/bold] tab. Picking a file previews its floor plan and size. - Pick a source: [bold]My library[/bold], [bold]Ship grids[/bold] or [bold]Maps[/bold]. Search narrows the list. - Pick a file and press [bold]Place[/bold]. - An outline follows the cursor. R turns it. Click to put it down. Escape or right click drops it.
You have 60 seconds to place it. One reference loads at a time across the server; if another is loading, try again in a moment. Files over 1.5 MiB are refused, which lets every ship through and keeps stations out. A reference is ordinary map content and counts against your limits. Delete it when you're done with it.
